data.name: Uli
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German name Ulrich, meaning 'wealth ruler'. Ulrich is a name of Germanic origin, composed of the elements 'ul' meaning 'ultra, wealth' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler, power'. The name was popular among early Christians, with several saints named Ulrich.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner courage and strength.

in_hebrew.name: אולי
in_hebrew.meaning: אולי הוא השם של אלוהים, אולי הוא שומר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אולי מקורו בעברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא אור' או 'אור אלוהים'. הוא קשור למילה 'אור' שפירושה אור, ויכול להיות קשור גם למילה 'אל' שפירושה אלוהים. השם אולי משמש גם כקיצור לשמות ארוכים יותר שמתחילים ב'אול'.

in_greek.name: Ουλί
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ουλί είναι πιθανόν σύντομη μορφή ονομάτων που αρχίζουν με 'Οὐλ', τα οποία προέρχονται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'אוֹר' (אוֹר) που σημαίνει 'φως'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το φως είναι σύμβολο της παρουσίας και της αγάπης του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Uli
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Uli fortasse derivatur ex hebraeo 'אוֹר' (or), quod significat 'lux'. In traditione christiana, lux est symbolum amoris et praesentiae Dei. Nomen Uli potest etiam esse forma abbreviata nominum longiorum quae cum 'Uol' incipiunt.

in_english.name: Uli
in_english.meaning: Uli means God is light or Light of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Uli is of Hebrew origin, derived from the word 'אוֹר' (or), meaning 'light'. It is often associated with the concept of God as a source of light and guidance. In Christian tradition, light symbolizes God's love, truth, and salvation. Uli may also be a shortened form of longer names beginning with 'Uol' or 'Ul'.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Uli carries the meaning 'wealth ruler'. This suggests a connection to the idea of God as the ultimate provider and ruler, reflecting the belief that all material and spiritual blessings come from God. The name also highlights the concept that those who follow God are not only possessed of spiritual wealth but are also given the power to rule and steward the blessings they receive from God. As such, the name Uli carries a message of faith, trust, and dependence on God's provision and guidance, while also empowering the bearer to wield God's blessings as a steward and ruler.
